P30-10#

from myst_nb import glue

glue("set_name", set_name, display=False)

file = open('{}-{}.yaml'.format(set_name,"PNOF5"), 'r')
yaml_data = yaml.safe_load(file)
MAD_P30_PNOF5 = get_total_MAD_of_whole_set(yaml_data)
glue("MAD_P30_PNOF5", "{:.2f}".format(MAD_P30_PNOF5), display=False)

file = open('{}-{}.yaml'.format(set_name,"PNOF7"), 'r')
yaml_data = yaml.safe_load(file)
MAD_P30_PNOF7 = get_total_MAD_of_whole_set(yaml_data)
glue("MAD_P30_PNOF7", "{:.2f}".format(MAD_P30_PNOF7), display=False)

file = open('{}-{}.yaml'.format(set_name,"GNOF"), 'r')
yaml_data = yaml.safe_load(file)
MAD_P30_GNOF = get_total_MAD_of_whole_set(yaml_data)
glue("MAD_P30_GNOF", "{:.2f}".format(MAD_P30_GNOF), display=False)

Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) of the set

  • Computed as the sum of all Absolute Deviations (AD) divided by 30 (the number of reactions on the set).
